an easier, a better and the recommended solution is to use the new
extractDataFrame(), e.g.

On Sun, Mar 30, 2008 at 6:10 PM, Jay <j....@griffith.edu.au> wrote:
>
> Hi Mark,
>
> thanks.
> I found the function getUnitGroupNamesFromUgcMap() is quite slow...
> maybe because of my machine.

It is slow because it has to read the complete CDF list structure and
traverse through unit by unit to extract unit and group names. The
current solution is suboptimal but we hope to speed it up
substantially if we get time to implement a helper function in
affxparser before the next Bioconductor release. Also, note that the
second time you call the method it is much faster. This is because it
caches the results to file.

/Henrik
